name: Adzviser Marketo
description:
Connect your Marketo data to Claude. No more exporting CSVs or uploading files, Adzviser brings your reporting data directly into the conversation.

Ask about leads created and emails sent. Compare programs, dig into how each campaign is performing, and understand what's changed over time. Whether you're checking last week's activity or putting together a monthly report, start with a question and let Claude build the analysis you need.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Adzviser Marketo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Adzviser Marketo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://marketo.mcp.adzviser.com/http. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Adzviser Marketo MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adzviser Marketo provides these MCP tools: list_metrics_and_breakdowns_marketo, list_workspace, and retrieve_reporting_data.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Adzviser Marketo?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Adzviser Marketo in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Adzviser Marketo MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adzviser Marketo requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Adzviser Marketo is developed by Adzviser LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
